title: Scalar compatibility of the etale sum-extension counit
statement:
Fix a field $k$ of characteristic $p>0$ and a prime $\ell\ne p$. All schemes below are separated and finite type over $k$, and all maps are $k$-morphisms [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. Let $A\to B$ be a unital map of finite commutative rings killed by powers of $\ell$, and choose $N=\ell^n\geq1$ annihilating both. On small ordinary etale sites use constant-ring module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] and $T_T=(-)_B=-\otimes^L_{A_T}B_T$ [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. Write $D^b_{ctf}$ for bounded constructible complexes of finite Tor amplitude, as in [det-sp-et-proet-adjunction-transfer], and $R_T(1)=\mu_{N,T}\otimes_{(\mathbf Z/N)_T}R_T$ for $R=A,B$ [lem-asd-finite-etale-twist-line]. Let $e:U\to V$ be separated etale of finite type. Write $E_R=De_{\Sigma!,R}$ for exact sum extension and $E_R\dashv e_R^*$ for its derived adjunction, with sum/evaluation counit $v_R$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sum-extension, lem-amb-etale-adjoint-locality]. Let $\sigma_e:T_VE_A\xrightarrow{\sim}E_BT_U$ be the summandwise tensor comparison on K-flat representatives [lem-sp-et-proet-coefficient-compatibility], and $a_e:T_Ue_A^*\xrightarrow{\sim}e_B^*T_V$ the canonical pullback/tensor comparison [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. For every $K\in D^b_{ctf}(V_{et},A)$ one has
$$v_{B,T_VK}\,E_B(a_e(K))\,\sigma_e(e_A^*K)=T_V(v_{A,K}).$$
Thus $a_e$ is the mate of $\sigma_e^{-1}$. For a chosen compactification of $e$, the same assertion holds with the compact-support coefficient map and its counit after the counit-preserving normalization [lem-asd-etale-compact-support-normalization].

proof.text: Widen a Tor interval [a,b] to [min(a,b),b], so its endpoints are ordered even for the zero object. Apply [lem-sf-etale-flat-model] to obtain a bounded flat representative P with Q(P) isomorphic to K. For e^*K, apply exact inverse image to P: flatness is preserved by the source FlatModuleCat pullback instance, proved by the geometric-flatness criterion [lem-sfb-etale-flat-geometric-fibers], and zero terms stay zero in the same interval. Apply [lem-kun-flat-bounded-tor-amplitude] to this complex, then transport through the exact localization comparison and Q(P) isomorphic to K. For constructibility, convert to the source predicate using [lem-weil-pbc-constructible-etale-module-sheaf-comparison], apply its proved boundedConstructible.mapDerivedCategory_upperStar (exact cohomology comparison and [prop-constructible-pullback]), and convert back. This proves that e^*K is an allowed ctf input without a line tensor or a twist.

proof.text: Compare the exact-localization sum adjunction with mapDerivedCategoryAdjunction: both have the same counit on Q(P), as follows from the localization counit formula and the exact functor comparison. Equality follows by localization extensionality. Identify the inverse of properOpenCoefficientPullbackIso with the scalar-adjunction mate of the exact restriction-of-scalars square, using the proved canonical scalarPullback_eq helper of [lem-sfb-etale-proetale-scalar-mate] and transport through leftDerivedUpperStarIsoMapDerivedCategory. The generic scalarOpenInverseMate and uniq_eq_conjugate helpers in [lem-coef-etale-open-tensor] are statements for four arbitrary adjunctions, with no open-immersion hypothesis: their iterated-mate identity identifies the other transpose with sumCoefficientIso.inv. Apply mateEquiv_counit_symm, replace both identifications, precompose with sumCoefficientIso.hom and cancel its inverse. This proves the first clause directly for every K. These proved helpers are the direct mate argument currently also used in the model module; no model theorem, new hypothesis, or separate chain computation is needed.

source.place: Charts: integral summation over etale fibres

proof.text: For the second clause apply injectivity of the inverse B-adjunction hom equivalence. Its two values are E_B(a_e(K)) followed by the B-counit and the counit expression of the mate. The formula mateEquiv_counit from [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate] evaluates the latter as sigma.inv at e^*K followed by T_V of the A-counit. Precompose with sigma.hom; cancel hom/inv and apply the first clause.

source.place: Charts: integral summation over etale fibres

proof.text: For every compactification c and normalization records N_A,N_B, write C_R=normalizedSumComparison. Naturality of C_B at a_e(K) moves the compact support functor applied to a_e(K) past C_B. Apply the sum coefficient square of [lem-sp-et-proet-coefficient-compatibility] at e^*K, which is allowed by the first step, and reassociate. The first clause now replaces sigma.hom followed by E_B(a_e(K)) and the B-counit with T_V of the A-counit. Functoriality gives T_V(C_A followed by the A-counit). The C_R are exactly the normalized comparisons of [lem-asd-etale-compact-support-normalization] already specified in the theorem; no choice or change of compact counit is made.
